responses.demo_ai_experience: I use AI primarily for programming. In the past I have used the free AI features of various IDEs (Copilot, Antigravity, Windsurf) to assist with coding. Recently, about 2 months ago, I've started using Opencode with Deepseek to write and edit simple scripts for me. It has been very convenient when I want a simple tool written.
